GLOBALSAAS PRIVACY NOTICE

GlobalSaaS Technologies Private Limited (the Data Fiduciary) provides workflow software. Our Data
Protection Officer, based in India, can be reached at dpo@globalsaas.io.

NOTICE
This Notice is provided before we collect your personal data. We collect your name, work email,
IP address and product usage events, for the specific purpose of providing and securing the
service and for billing.

CONSENT
The consent we seek is free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, and is given
through a clear affirmative action. Each purpose has its own unticked checkbox. You may withdraw
your consent at any time from Account Settings > Privacy, and withdrawal is as easy as giving
consent.

INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS
Your personal data is primarily stored on servers located in India. Certain Data Processors we
engage may process it in the United States, Singapore and Ireland. We do not transfer personal
data to any country or territory notified as restricted by the Central Government under Section
16 of the DPDPA, 2023, and all such transfers are protected by contractual safeguards and
encryption in transit.

DATA PROCESSORS
We engage Data Processors only under a valid written contract which limits them to processing on
our documented instructions and imposes reasonable security safeguards. We remain responsible
for compliance.

SIGNIFICANT DATA FIDUCIARY
We have been notified as a Significant Data Fiduciary. We undertake a Data Protection Impact
Assessment and an independent audit once every twelve months and furnish a report of significant
observations to the Data Protection Board. Our Data Protection Officer is based in India and
reports to the board of directors.

SECURITY
We encrypt data in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256, enforce role-based access
control and multi-factor authentication, retain access logs for one year, and maintain
data backups. We run mandatory annual privacy training and quarterly access reviews.

BREACH NOTIFICATION
We will intimate each affected Data Principal without delay and provide the Data Protection Board
with detailed information within seventy-two hours of becoming aware of a breach.

RETENTION AND ERASURE
We retain account data for 36 months after account closure. When you withdraw consent, or once
the purpose is no longer served, we erase that personal data and instruct our Data Processors to
erase their copies. Where the Income-tax Act, 1961 requires us to retain invoices for longer, we
retain them for that period and erase them thereafter.

YOUR RIGHTS
Request a summary of your personal data, correction of inaccurate or incomplete data, or erasure
from Account Settings > Privacy > My Data, or by writing to dpo@globalsaas.io. You may nominate
another individual to exercise your rights in the event of death or incapacity.

GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL
Grievance Officer: Mr S. Menon, grievance@globalsaas.io. We respond within 15 days and in no case
later than ninety days. You may thereafter complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
